title: Transarterial embolization of aldosterone producing adenoma of the adrenal gland – the DRAMA study
summary: The aim of this study is to use a minimally invasive procedure; embolization of the diseased adrenal gland, aiming to lower successfully the blood pressure and consequently alleviate the symptoms related to the condition. An additional benefit to the well known surgical therapy would be the expansion of the treatment options for this clinical condition. This alternative therapy could represent a good treatment option, especially for patients with foreknown contraindications for surgical Approach and / or for patients who did not benefit from surgical Treatment.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-Patients with a history of an arterial hypertension for more than 12 months, proven to have unilateral primary aldosteronism (PA) through adrenal venous sampling procedure
-Age: 18 to 75 years 
-Patients not suitable for surgery or unwilling to undergo  surgical resection
-Laboratory values like studyprotocol.
Exclusion criteria:
·Symptomatic peripheral arterial disease (PAD)
·History of obstructive sleep apnea
·Anatomical difficulties: High-grade aortic stenosis, access site impossibilities
·Renal insufficiency (eGFR  < 30 ml/min) 
·Severe contrast media intolerance
·Pregnancy
